trails.title: Obsidian Loop
trails.summary: High-country meadows, volcanic glass and rocky slopes in the Three Sisters Wilderness.

trails.title: Tamolitch Blue Pool
trails.summary: A forested stretch of the McKenzie River Trail leading to a pool fed by water flowing beneath ancient lava.

trails.title: Sahalie and Koosah Falls
trails.summary: Two waterfalls on the upper McKenzie River, where water plunges over ancient lava flows.

trails.title: Multnomah–Wahkeena Loop
trails.summary: Waterfalls, mossy forest and recovering woodland along the steep ravines of the Columbia River Gorge.

trails.title: Trail of Ten Falls
trails.summary: A forest trail descending into Silver Creek Canyon and winding past waterfalls and moss-covered cliffs.

trails.title: Smith Rock
trails.summary: Golden volcanic spires, the winding Crooked River and distant Cascade peaks in Oregon’s high desert.
